member.name: T:RockwellAutomation.FactoryTalkLogixEcho.Api.Client.IFileHandle
member.summary:
Defines a set of methods used to represent a file exchange between Client and Echo Service.
Before the file can be used as a parameter in any operation, such as Download, it must first be shared with the Echo Service. Sharing the file involves copying it to a different location where it can be accessed by this service. IFileHandle represents the shared file and allows the copy to be removed when it is no longer needed.
The file handle can be used to perform multiple operations both in sequence and simultaneously. The original file is never modified and is accessed only once, when the handle is created. Subsequent changes to the original file have no effect on the shared one.
After creation, the handle stays valid for at least one hour. To free the handle earlier, please use the Dispose method. For background operations such as Download, the handle does not need to be kept until the operation is finished. Instead, it can be disposed of immediately after the operation is started.
